name: PlanBench-XL
intro: PlanBench-XL 是面向大规模工具生态的交互式长程规划 benchmark，包含 327 个零售任务和 1,665 个工具。它评估 Agent 在工具可见性受限时能否检索可用工具、分解隐式子目标、处理缺失/失败/干扰工具，并沿长路径逐步恢复到最终目标。
build_method: LLM生成与过滤, 类型化工具合成, 状态图路径枚举, 可执行后端
metric: Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, Avg Turns, Mean EDT, Search/Call Ratio, ITCR, UIRR
task_type: Agent任务, 工具调用, 长程规划
eval_feature: 56种数据类型, 工具检索上限30, 最短路径5至9, 100轮上限, 三类保路径阻断
scale: 327个零售任务, 1,665个工具, 56种数据类型
task_type_en: Agent task, Tool use, Long-horizon planning
build_method_en: LLM generation and filtering, typed-tool synthesis, state-graph path enumeration, executable backend
eval_feature_en: 56 datatypes, retrieval capped at 30 tools, shortest paths of 5-9 calls, 100-turn cap, three path-preserving blocker types
intro_en: PlanBench-XL is an interactive long-horizon planning benchmark for large-scale tool ecosystems, with 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools. It evaluates whether agents can retrieve usable tools under limited visibility, infer implicit sub-goals, handle missing, failing, or distracting tools, and recover over long alternative tool-use paths.
metric_en: Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, Avg Turns, Mean EDT, Search/Call Ratio, ITCR, UIRR
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2606.22388 benchmark-construction, interaction, blocker, and metrics sections plus the official JiayuJeff/PlanBench-XL repository. An LLM proposes retail datatypes and tools before filtering vague, redundant, or unrealistic candidates. The released executable ecosystem has 56 datatypes and 1,665 tools with one-to-five typed inputs and one output, canonical names plus aliases, five noisy sibling variants, concrete backend records, and fixed unhelpful noisy outputs. Tasks define initial datatypes and a goal, enumerate state-graph solution paths, retain solvable instances whose shortest valid paths require 5-9 calls, verbalize 327 natural-language queries, and execute a valid path for the gold answer. Agents can retrieve by input, output, or bridge conditions, receive at most 30 tools, and act through retrieve, tool-call, or answer for up to 100 turns. Optional explicit, implicit, and semantically misleading blockers replace path-critical tools while preserving at least one valid path. Evaluation reports Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, average turns, mean EDT, search/call ratio, invalid tool-call rate, and untrusted-input rejection rate.
